topic: Cleaning duplicate frame data in VA
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on the cleaning and handling of new VA (Video Analytics) data provided by a team member. Initial attempts to remove duplicates from `frame_va` were made, but concerns were raised that different values for VA and dwell-time might exist even for the same road/frame combination. It was agreed that while the current sandbox data is clean and usable, there are underlying data quality issues regarding duplicate records.

Ultimately, despite initial resistance to cleaning, [me] decided to proceed with cleaning up the duplicates in the provided dataset.
decisions: The team will continue working with the cleaned VA data available on the sandbox environment.
action_items: [me] informed Marina about the data quality issues and proceeded to clean the duplicate records.
